name: stypr
notes:
stypr.network (AS400671, part of AS-STYPR) is a multi-purpose Internet Service Provider(ISP) providing secure and reliable automated network.
Main use of the network is intended for legal cybersecurity researches.

BGP Large Communities are supported. Peers are encouraged to use them when importing, validating, or applying policy to routes received from our network.

The network infrastructure and dashboard systems are operated, maintained, and managed by stypr. Any issue resolution may take up to 24 hours.

Sales emails sent to our mailbox are silently ignored. Please do not expect a response to sales-related inquiries.
